extracted.intended_audience: Wolfram Language programmers and authors creating programmatic notebook documents
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and reference for programmatically generating, styling, structuring, evaluating, importing/exporting, and deploying Wolfram Notebook documents using the Wolfram Language. Covers functions, template workflows, interactivity, and incremental generation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Symbolic document paradigm
rubrics_metrics.description: The Wolfram Language's symbolic document paradigm makes it uniquely easy to create complex structured documents programmatically, including both graphical elements and dynamic interactivity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer representing documents and cells as symbolic expressions so they can be constructed, transformed, and evaluated programmatically; this underlies the other functions and workflows on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: CreateDocument — create a complete formatted document from a list of expressions
rubrics_metrics.description: CreateDocument — create a complete formatted document from a list of expressions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use CreateDocument when you need a ready-to-use formatted notebook composed from expressions; this produces a document-ready notebook with formatting and cells created programmatically.

rubrics_metrics.name: CreateNotebook — create a blank notebook of the specified type
rubrics_metrics.description: CreateNotebook — create a blank notebook of the specified type
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use CreateNotebook to instantiate an empty notebook of a given type (for example to programmatically add cells later).

rubrics_metrics.name: DocumentNotebook — symbolic representation of a document notebook
rubrics_metrics.description: DocumentNotebook — symbolic representation of a document notebook
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use DocumentNotebook to represent the entire notebook/document as a symbolic object for manipulation, templating, or programmatic export.

rubrics_metrics.name: TextCell and ExpressionCell — symbolic representations of cells
rubrics_metrics.description: TextCell, ExpressionCell — symbolic representations of cells in any style
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Construct document content by creating TextCell and ExpressionCell objects with appropriate style names and options to control formatting and semantics of each cell.

rubrics_metrics.name: NotebookEvaluate and SelectionEvaluate — evaluating notebook contents
rubrics_metrics.description: NotebookEvaluate — evaluate the contents of a notebook; SelectionEvaluate — evaluate a selection
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use NotebookEvaluate to run all evaluatable content in a notebook programmatically; use SelectionEvaluate to run only a portion. Useful when generating documents that include computed output.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document structure primitives (CellGroup, Grid, TabView, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Document Structure: CellGroup — symbolic representation of a cell group, with any cells closed; Grid — arbitrary 2D layout of expressions, graphics, etc., with spanning, frames, etc.; TabView, OpenerView, SlideView, FlipView, MenuView — provide various structured/layout patterns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these primitives to organize document content into logical groups, multi-column/tabbed/slidable views, and other structured layouts rather than relying on ad-hoc cell sequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document styling (StyleDefinitions, Style, Text and layout options)
rubrics_metrics.description: Document Styling: StyleDefinitions — overall cascading stylesheet definitions for a document; Style — specify a style name or styling options for any element of a document; Text — text to be embedded anywhere in a document; options such as Background, CellMargins, Framed, Highlighted, Panel, WindowSize, WindowTitle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define or apply stylesheet-level StyleDefinitions for consistent cascading styling. Use Style wrappers and cell options to control presentation; set window and document-level properties when generating documents for specific output formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Active elements and annotation for interactivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Active Elements & Annotation: Hyperlink — create a hyperlink to any URL or any part of the document; Tooltip, Mouseover, Checkbox, ListAnimate, Manipulate, Defer, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include interactive widgets and annotations to make generated documents dynamic. Use Defer to include evaluatable input cells, Manipulate and controls for parameterized interactivity, and Hyperlink/Tooltip/Mouseover for navigation and annotation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Graphics inclusion and plotting primitives
rubrics_metrics.description: Graphics: Import — import graphics etc. to include; Graphics, Inset, ListPlot, ListLinePlot, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Embed graphics by importing external images or using built-in plotting and Graphics primitives. Use Inset and Grid to place graphics within layouts; ensure plots are generated programmatically when creating automated reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Template-based document generation (GenerateDocument, TemplateApply, NotebookTemplate)
rubrics_metrics.description: Template-Based Document Generation: GenerateDocument — create a formatted document by applying a template notebook; TemplateApply, NotebookTemplate, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer template-based workflows for consistent document structure and formatting. Use NotebookTemplate and TemplateApply (with GenerateDocument) to fill templates with programmatically generated content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Text generation and templating utilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Text Generation: StringTemplate, TextString, LLMSynthesize, LLMResourceFunction — generate text using templates and LLMs; LLMResourceFunction — generate text using prompts from the Wolfram Prompt Repository.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use StringTemplate/TextString for deterministic templating and LLMSynthesize/LLMResourceFunction when incorporating LLM-based natural-language generation; combine with templates for hybrid workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chat notebooks and LLM-driven additions
rubrics_metrics.description: Chat Notebooks: ChatEvaluate — add a chat response to a notebook using an LLM
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integrate LLM responses into notebooks via ChatEvaluate to add conversational outputs or generated content inline in documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deployment and export (CloudDeploy, Export, NotebookPrint, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Deployment: CloudDeploy — deploy a document to the cloud; Export — export to the web and other media, in HTML, PDF, XML, etc.; NotebookPrint — print an expression or a notebook to a default printer; Save As, Send To, Print, Deploy — make a document or any part of it uneditable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan how generated documents will be consumed: export to appropriate formats, deploy to the cloud for sharing, or print. Use Deploy or other mechanisms to lock content if needed for distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incremental document generation (CellPrint, AttachCell, NotebookWrite, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Incremental Document Generation: CellPrint — insert a cell at the point where evaluation is being done; AttachCell — attach a floating cell to a part of the notebook or window; Print, NotebookWrite, Paste — other incremental insertion methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For interactive or live-generation scenarios, use CellPrint/AttachCell to produce output incrementally as evaluations proceed, rather than generating the whole notebook in one pass.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document import and reading (NotebookImport, NotebookGet, NotebookRead)
rubrics_metrics.description: Document Import: NotebookImport — import structured material from a notebook; NotebookGet, NotebookRead — related functions to read notebook content programmatically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use NotebookImport/NotebookGet/NotebookRead to ingest, transform, or repurpose existing notebooks as part of generation or automated report pipelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related tech notes and workflows for advanced features
rubrics_metrics.description: Related Tech Notes: Cells as Wolfram Language Expressions; Notebooks as Wolfram Language Expressions; Options for Cells; Options for Notebooks; Text and Font Options; Manipulating Notebooks from the Kernel; Notebooks as Documents; Formatted Output; Working with Stylesheets; Related Workflow Guides: Programmatic Notebook Operations; Creating and Organizing Interfaces; Creating Documents and Presentations; Special Types of Notebooks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult these deeper technical notes and workflow guides when implementing advanced manipulations, custom stylesheets, kernel-driven notebook creation, or specialized notebook types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of repositories and learning resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Related Guides & Repositories: Wolfram Function Repository, Wolfram Data Repository, Wolfram Prompt Repository, Wolfram Language Example Repository, Notebook Archive, Function Repository, Neural Net Repository, Prompt Repository.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage existing repository assets (functions, prompts, examples, data) and learning materials (Wolfram U, webinars, documentation) to accelerate document generation and reuse proven templates and functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automated reports and document formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Related Guides: Automated Reports; Document Formats; Text Generation; Overall Window Properties; Creating Palettes; Custom Interface Construction; Clipboard Operations; Low-Level Notebook Programming; Accessing Databases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When building automated reporting pipelines, consider the target document formats, integration points (databases, palettes), and low-level notebook programming options to ensure generated documents meet consumer expectations.
